description: A Medical Symptom Tracker that lets users log symptoms and associated factors, review their history, and see how symptom severity changes over time. This is a personal logging application, not a diagnostic tool.
requirements: Users can add a symptom entry with a symptom name, date and time, severity as an integer from 1 to 10, and duration in minutes as a nonnegative integer.
Each entry can include optional food, stress level, environmental factors, and free-text notes.
Users can view their saved symptom entries in chronological order, with the newest entry first.
Users can edit and delete existing entries.
Users can filter entries by symptom name and an inclusive date range.
Users can view a simple severity-over-time chart for a selected symptom using browser-native graphics.
Entries persist locally across application restarts or browser reloads.
The application rejects missing symptom names, invalid dates, severity outside 1–10, and negative duration with clear validation messages.
